subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: When an operator-session redirect write fails, should OpenClaw keep the proposed fail-closed suppression or add a durable, source-safe retry and recovery path?
rationale: This decides whether potentially sensitive operational text remains private at the cost of immediate visibility, or gains a recoverable delivery mechanism; it cannot be resolved from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Keep fail-closed suppression
options.body: Suppress the source-chat notice when redirect persistence fails and provide a documented operator recovery path.

options.title: Design source-safe retry
options.body: Add a bounded retry or durable recovery mechanism that preserves source suppression without a source-chat fallback.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed suppression
recommendation.body: Suppress the source-chat notice when redirect persistence fails and provide a documented operator recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed branch and PR body identify this precise policy choice, although final approval should come from the relevant current-main owner after a history review.
